title: Burnham says he wants to cut welfare bill 'as soon as we possibly can'
description: Opponents have questioned the Budget's lack of detail on welfare reform, with the prime minister not outlining a timetable for any reductions.

title: 'Painful' years ahead, think tanks warn, as living standards set to fall
description: Budget forecasts show growth in living standards grinding almost to a halt.

title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
description: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.

title: Met refers itself to police watchdog over letter about Meghan's father
description: The police force faces scrutiny over its handling of a letter containing allegations about Meghan's father.

title: Jury shown CCTV of Huntingdon train staff using frying pan in defence
description: A train crew member shows "sheer courage and bravery in seeking to save lives", a court hears.

title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
description: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.

title: Hundreds of GP practices lose online services after collapse of tech firm
description: It will cause huge disruption in some parts of England and Wales, say GP leaders.

title: Burnham 'ready to support' Poundland staff as retailer faces collapse
description: Poundland's bosses are filing a notice of intention to appoint administrators to the business.

title: Grealish dropped by Everton after 'breach of club discipline'
description: Jack Grealish is left out of Everton's Carabao Cup tie with Newcastle United on Thursday "due to a breach of club discipline".
